[P2] Require native completion before reusing a Python worker

In `recovery_evidence("python")`, changing only the victim's `endedAtMs` from 40 to 50 leaves every validation check satisfied, although recovery starts at 40 on the same worker/process. This accepts overlapping native requests on one Python process as recovered capacity, contradicting the suite's Python placement rule. When recovery reuses the victim's Python process, require its admission to be at or after the victim's native completion, and cover overlapping intervals in both validation phases.
